subject: integration
name: Bitcoin price standard (BTC_PRICE_0_1)
summary: Defines one read: the price of bitcoin in a fiat currency, as a decimal string with its time and the number of sources that agreed. A provider with several sources takes the median and fails when two differ by over 2 percent or fewer than 2 answer; a single on-chain feed answers as 1 source and refuses an update over 2 hours old. Those limits are marked provisional and the source count is the provider's own claim, so nothing here checks a price. The row connects to nothing; providers are judged on their own rows. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
